| [ADR-041](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-041.md) | A LIT whose lawful full text was sought and not reached is Unavailable, not Deferred | `Deferred` on a LIT held two different situations: a work nobody has yet tried to read, and a work whose lawful full text was looked for and not reached. The owner asked for the two to be told apart. The lit-statuses vocabulary gains `Unavailable` ("No copy reached"), and `Deferred` keeps "no attempt recorded". 177 of the 345 Deferred LITs had a status note recording a failed search, and they move. Among them are 8 where a lawful copy exists but this client could not fetch it. Three were left Deferred because their notes record no search. The other 168 stay Deferred. | Proposed |
| [ADR-046](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-046.md) | A TERM may be Proposed, and rival, complement or narrow another | A TERM's status is the standing of its definition, not a credence: a Proposed term is a definition recorded and not adopted. TERM gains the relations the record already uses elsewhere: `rivals` (symmetric, THEORY's from [ADR-022](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-022.md)), for definitions that cannot both be adopted for one use; `complements` (symmetric, CLAIM's from [ADR-032](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-032.md)), for definitions in force side by side; and `refines`/`refined_by` (QUESTION's), for a special case that stays in force. `supersedes` is kept for an adoption that retires the earlier term. Applied to [TERM-050](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-050.md)/[TERM-061](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-061.md) (complements) and [TERM-010](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-010.md)/[TERM-043](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-043.md) (refines, in place of a `supersedes` that retired nothing). Rejected: new relation names (`proposes_for`, `alternatives_to`), a separate CONCEPT scheme, a TERM-only status vocabulary, and keeping candidate definitions in prose. | Proposed |
